title: Metrics

score.title: Account score
score.contentLine: Recipient-weighted insights score of sent emails
score.outcomeLine: Complaints and hard bounces against sends
score.insufficient: Not enough sends in the last 30 days.

details.open: See what makes up the score
details.title: Score details
details.contentOnly: Only the content sub-score counts until the window has enough sends.
details.compositionNote: Outcome leads. Flawless content never lands more than 1.5 above outcome, and a guardrail warning or pause caps the score at 6.9 or 4.9, by construction.
details.contentSection: Content · what weighs, weighted by recipients
details.factorMeta: {emails, plural, one {# email} other {# emails}} · {recipients} recipients
details.noFactors: Every check passes on every scored email.
details.passing: {count, plural, one {# check passing} other {# checks passing}} across the whole volume
details.outcomeNote: Rates over {sent} sends. The lines follow Google Postmaster: keep complaints under 0.10% and never reach 0.30%.
details.liftNone: Nothing left to gain from content. What remains is in the outcome rates.

open.title: Open rate
open.prefetchedHint: Tracking-image fetches a mail client or security scanner made before anyone opened. They never count toward the open rate.

emptyHint: Metrics appear after your first send — POST /emails.
